title: odontochilus integrus
intro: Odontochilus integrus, commonly known as the "Chinese Dragon's Mouth," is a plant species in the orchid family (Orchidaceae). It has been traditionally used in medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Odontochilus integrus include its vasodilatory, anti-hypertensive, and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
